ارتقين (form VIII)
# اِرْتَقَيْنَ (irtaqayna) /ir.ta.qaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# اُرْتُقِينَ (urtuqīna) /ur.tu.qiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# اِرْتَقِينَ (irtaqīna) /ir.ta.qiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
